Those who believed, emigrated and fought in the cause of Allah hope for His mercy, and He is Forgiving and Merciful.
Those the angels take while wronging themselves, claiming oppression though Allah's earth was spacious for emigration, face Hell, except the helpless; emigrants for Allah find abundance and reward.
Those who emigrated and fought and those who sheltered them are the true believers; later emigrants are of them, and blood relatives are more entitled to one another.
Those who emigrated for Allah after being wronged will be settled well in this world, with a greater reward in the Hereafter, being patient and relying on their Lord.
Your Lord is Forgiving and Merciful to those who emigrated after being compelled to renounce their religion, then fought and were patient.
Those who emigrated for Allah's cause and then were killed or died will receive a good provision from Allah and an entrance that pleases them.
Believers are told Allah's earth is spacious, so they may emigrate to worship Him alone; the patient who rely on Him get chambers in Paradise, and Allah provides for all.
Shares also go to the poor emigrants driven from their homes, to those settled in al-Madinah who love and prefer them, and to those after them who pray for forgiveness.
